harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 and branch_stock on node1. The supplied records are preserved. stock_app can read stock and update only quantity; auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs. Separate credentials are stored securely on node2. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification without changing Ubuntu 24.04.3 or kernel 6.8.0-71.
actions_performed: Installed PostgreSQL 16 server on node1 and client on node2
Imported the supplied stock.sql into branch_stock
Created separate SCRAM credentials for stock_app and auditor
Restricted database access to node2 and stored credentials in separate root-owned mode-600 files
Verified all allowed and denied operations directly from node2
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities, recovery, data, credentials, and permissions

evidence.summary: The original SQL checksum and records match the final database contents: stock PAPER=40, LABELS=18; supplier costs PAPER=3.25, LABELS=1.75.

evidence.requirement: stock_app may read stock and update only quantities, without schema or supplier_costs access
evidence.summary: Functional tests prove stock reads and rolled-back quantity updates succeed, while supplier-cost reads, schema creation, and SKU updates fail.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Auditor reads both tables successfully and stock updates are denied.

evidence.requirement: Separate credentials established securely on node2
evidence.summary: Separate root-owned mode-600 pgpass files exist, both roles have passwords, and their stored password verifiers are distinct.

evidence.requirement: Legacy OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic before and after restart.
Baseline boot ID 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137 changed to 12d19357-12cb-4c9b-96d1-d278953bb5bd; PostgreSQL, records, roles, and remote access recovered.
Baseline boot ID 63f96994-951b-4597-aac7-233c38c86ce0 changed to f17e6efb-ab4f-4ca5-b6df-dba0fc254715; credentials, client access, records, and role restrictions recovered.
